title: Rows for record tests
statement: For a natural number $k$, types $Q$ and $T$, a predicate $P$ on an optional state and a tag, and a record-test index, define a one-work-tape Turing machine whose state type is the phase type assigned to that index. The state index uses a scan machine that reads the recorded state; a tag index uses a scan machine that tests the recorded tag against $P$ and the state carried by that index; backward indices use a backward-skip machine; and forward and verdict indices use skip machines.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on an optional state and a tag
The input is a record-test index
caveat: The scan, skip, and backward-skip machine constructions are referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
